summary: Iteration 1: First-pass full-stack testing of VolleyPro. Created pytest regression suite (20 tests) covering auth, quick & league creation, ownership scoping, jornada modes (femenil/varonil/mixto), match patch/result, reagendar max-2 enforcement, recalcular, and public view + branch filter. All 20 backend tests pass. Frontend Playwright flows verified register->dashboard, login (wrong + correct password), Quick & League wizard creation, tournament detail tabs (with conditional Reagendar tab on League only), jornada submission, public view rendering with search and branch filter, dashboard delete. No critical bugs found.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend register/login set httpOnly cookie AND return token in body (frontend uses Bearer). Cookie has secure=False — acceptable in preview, but should be True in production behind HTTPS.

Mixto jornada uses _agendar twice and concatenates; works correctly but ag_var slots reuse the same court ids, which is the intended behavior (same canchas, sequential blocks). Verified by test (max_fem <= min_var).

reagendar endpoint counts BOTH teams of the match against their max-2 quota; this is enforced correctly. Note: even when destino='jornada' (move to another jornada), the counter still increments — confirm with PM if this is desired (currently any reagendado action consumes a permit).
DELETE /api/tournaments/{tid} does not remove deletion side-effects on jornadas embedded in user content beyond cascading match deletion — fine since only the owner can delete.

_distribuir_grupos mutates the input equipos list (sort + adds 'club' field). Not a functional bug but a side effect to be aware of; since equipos is a fresh list per call from model_dump() it is fine.
server.py is ~830 lines — within acceptable limits; consider splitting into auth/, tournaments/, matches/, public/ routers if it grows.
test_credentials: Created at runtime via /api/auth/register: TEST_a_<rand>@volleypro.com / Password123! (and similar). Demo seeded creds in /app/memory/test_credentials.md not used by tests.
seed_data_creation: All test data created at runtime with TEST_ prefix; one TestCleanup test deletes one tournament to verify cascade. Some test tournaments remain in DB (acceptable).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py runs in ~5s and is the regression entry point. Frontend routes are /register, /login, /dashboard, /create/quick, /create/league, /t/{id} (NOT /tournament/{id}), /public/{slug}. Token persisted in localStorage as 'vp_token'. Public view: GET /api/public/{slug}?branch=femenil|varonil. Quick tournaments DO NOT have Reagendar tab; only Leagues do. Register flow may carry forward CTA intent (cta-create-league navigates to /register then forwards to /create/league after success) — going directly to /register lands on /dashboard. League jornada in 'mixto' mode places femenil in 1st half and varonil in 2nd half on same courts (verified). Reagendar increments counter for both teams of the match; 3rd attempt for any team returns 400.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found in this iteration.
